query.description: One PromQL expression, such as up or sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m])).

time.description: When to evaluate it: ISO 8601 with an offset (2026-11-11T09:00:00Z) or relative to now (-1h, now-30m, now). Default: now.

limit.description: Most series to return; the connection and the endpoint cap it.
